title: Have the backing before you begin
odia:
କଳି ଯେବେ କରିବସିବ
ସଙ୍ଗେ ଥିବ ଭାଇ
ଦୁଧ ଯେବେ ଖାଇ ବସିବ
ଘରେ ଥିବ ଗାଈ।
literal_meaning: When you enter a quarrel, have a brother beside you; when you sit down to drink milk, have a cow at home.
meaning_odia: କୌଣସି କାମରେ ପଶିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତାହା ପାଇଁ ଦରକାରୀ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଓ ସାଧନ ଥିବା କଥା। କଳି ବେଳେ ପାଖରେ ଭାଇର ସାହାରା ଓ ଦୁଧ ପାଇଁ ଘରେ ଗାଈ—ଏହି ଦୁଇ ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଆଶା ସହିତ ତାହାର ଆଧାରକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Each half pairs an intention with something that supports it: a brother’s presence in a quarrel, a cow as a source of milk. Read more broadly, the saying asks whether the necessary backing or means are in place before an undertaking begins. This broader reading is editorial.
usage_example: A group promises a large community meal before arranging ingredients and helpers. Someone recalls the saying to bring the discussion back to the people and supplies needed. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The rhyme ଭାଇ / ଗାଈ links human support with a household resource. One stands beside the speaker; the other supplies what the speaker wants. Their parallel positions give the two scenes a shared practical point.

witnesses.note: Recognizable corresponding brother/cow saying, but corrupted as ଥବ, misplaced ବସିବ, ଘ 1ରେ and ଥୁବ. Not an exact wording authority.
Corroborates complete lexical wording; କରି ବସିବ separated whereas upload joins କରିବସିବ. Upload supplies four-line arrangement. No separate source gloss.

odia_summary: କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଦରକାରୀ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଓ ସାଧନ ଥିବା।
english_summary: An undertaking needs the people or resources that can sustain it.
